conservation_status.description: This species is endemic to the coast of Alentejo in southwest Portugal where it has a restricted area of occupancy of less than 20 km². There are various subpopulations that have undergone a decline, some of them hosting less than 50 individuals. The main threats are posed by urbanisation and infrastructure development for tourism. It is therefore assessed as Vulnerable under D2 but could also fulfil Criterion B2ab(i,ii,iii,v) if information on the number of locations, or whether the subpopulations are severely fragmented, becomes available.
